svg.text: A sequential pipeline with a PM approval between stages. Four LLM agents on gpt-4o-mini, every run traced in Langfuse.
Paste text or add several files
Review, edit, send to next stage
Returns the result to the UI
API key stays on the server
Called by the four LLM agents
A trace per run, a span per agent
LLM agent (a Prompt node and a gpt-4o-mini node)
PM reviews and approves, then sends the output to the next stage
